Data (src/domains/othello.py)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=4;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;opacity=60;strokeColor=#888888;verticalAlign=top;align=right;spacingRight=12;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="60" width="1140" height="200" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="lane1" value="2. Training (src/zoo/train.py, run by src/shellscripts/train_slice.sh on 4 EC2s)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=4;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;opacity=60;strokeColor=#888888;verticalAlign=top;align=right;spacingRight=12;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="290" width="1140" height="250" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="lane2" value="3. Admission, storage and testing" style="rounded=1;arcSize=4;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;opacity=60;strokeColor=#888888;verticalAlign=top;align=right;spacingRight=12;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="570" width="1140" height="300" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="syn" value="<b>Synthetic games</b><br>othello_world: random legal moves,<br>about 19 million games" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="100" width="250" height="66" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="cha" value="<b>Championship games</b><br>WTHOR archive: 137,548 human<br>games, 1977 to 2025" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="176" width="250" height="66" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="mix" value="<b>Three training sets</b><br>synthetic, championship,<br>mixed (both pools together)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="320" y="130" width="220" height="82" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="rules" value="<b>Rules engine replays every game</b><br>true board and legal moves<br>after every move; illegal games<br>dropped (none found)<br><br>split 80 / 10 / 10:<br>train / val / test" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="570" y="100" width="270" height="142" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="tok" value="<b>Tokens</b><br>one token per move: the square<br>played (60 squares, token 1 to 60)<br>a game = up to 59 tokens;<br>passes are not tokens<br><br>the whole game fits: no window" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="880" y="100" width="260" height="142" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="arch" value="<b>One model per cell</b><br><br>3 architectures:<br>transformer, LSTM, Mamba<br>3 scales: 4x128, 6x256, 8x512<br>3 training sets: synthetic,<br>championship, mixed<br>3 seeds: 0, 1, 2<br>= 81 models" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="330" width="260" height="190" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="obj" value="<b>Objective (teacher forcing)</b><br><br>input: moves 1 to t of a real game<br>output: a score for each of the 60<br>squares for move t+1<br><br>cross entropy at every position;<br>the model always reads the real<br>history, never its own guesses" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="340" y="330" width="300" height="190" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="bud" value="<b>Same budget for all</b><br><br>5,000 steps<br>256 games per step<br>(1,280,000 games)<br>AdamW, lr 3e-4,<br>200 warmup steps,<br>cosine decay" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="680" y="330" width="220" height="190" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="rec" value="<b>Outputs</b><br><br>model.pt (checkpoint)<br><br>training record:<br>final loss, val legal<br>move rate, sha256<br>of the checkpoint" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="940" y="330" width="200" height="190" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="adm" value="<b>Registry and admission</b><br>competence = legal move rate<br>on 1,000 val games;<br>admitted if at least 0.50<br>(81 of 81 admitted)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="610" width="260" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="s3" value="<b>Shared storage</b><br>S3: shared/group6/zoo/<br>one folder per model" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="340" y="610" width="220" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="score" value="<b>score_slice.sh</b><br>checks sha256, then runs D1, D2,<br>D3, D4 and fragility v1, v2<br>on 1,000 test games of the<br>model&#x27;s own training set" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="600" y="610" width="270" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="res" value="<b>Results</b><br>one JSON per model and test<br>(486 files, all status ok)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="910" y="610" width="230" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="ana" value="<b>Analysis (src/analysis/hypotheses.py, after tag prereg-v1.4)</b><br>master table, then H1, H2, H3 with the configuration bootstrap" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="600" y="760" width="540" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="note" value="<b>Data roles never mix: train = training only;</b><br>val = admission and fitting the diagnostics;<br>test = every final score" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="760" width="520" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell svg.text: How the Othello model zoo is trained and tested
2. Training (src/zoo/train.py, run by src/shellscripts/train_slice.sh on 4 EC2s)
one token per move: the square
the whole game fits: no window
input: moves 1 to t of a real game
output: a score for each of the 60
the model always reads the real
checks sha256, then runs D1, D2,
D3, D4 and fragility v1, v2
one JSON per model and test
master table, then H1, H2, H3 with the configuration bootstrap
Data roles never mix: train = training only;
val = admission and fitting the diagnostics;
